description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notifying that the Fiscal Management Report 2016 including Fiscal Strategy Statement - 2016 and Budget, Economic and Fiscal Position Report - 2016 is available for inspection
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the availability of the Fiscal Management Report - 2016, which is issued under Sections 4 and 7 of the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters related to fiscal management and government financial reporting, falling under the category of statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
